requirement.note: The document also supports the 30-day threshold, the written notice requirement, the at-fault cure notice, and the no-fault causes listed.

coverage.evidence: The Just Cause Ordinance shall not apply to certain types of residential property, including housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
coverage.note: The 15-year exemption is supported. The card omits the other exemptions (deed-restricted, hotel, hospital, dormitories, shared living). The 15 years is measured from an unspecified date, probably the ordinance's adoption or the present.

requirement.evidence: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
requirement.note: The June 30 publication, September 1 effective date and written notice requirement are also stated. The cutoff is 'constructed after February 1, 1995', so the card's 'on or before' is consistent.
